intents.label: Orient
intents.pedagogical_role: Open attention and establish a reason to learn

intents.label: Compare
intents.choose_when: Two or more named things must be told apart, and the same criteria apply to each.

boundaries.when: instances are being sorted by a rule rather than two things contrasted
one side is a wrong belief, not a legitimate alternative
one option must be judged better, not merely distinguished

intents.label: Explain
intents.choose_when: The learner must reason about instances they have not seen, and the difficulty is the idea itself — not its cause, its flow, its arrangement, or a representation of it.

boundaries.when: the objective asks WHY, and a mechanism links cause to result
something is followed as it moves or changes through a system
the difficulty is arrangement, containment, or hierarchy
a specific representation is on the page and must be read

intents.label: Explain cause and effect
intents.choose_when: The objective asks why, or what happens if, and there is a mechanism between cause and result that the learner must be able to state.

boundaries.when: there is no cause-and-effect chain, only meaning or structure
the emphasis is on what moves, not on what causes
order matters but no causal mechanism does
the chain is logical rather than physical

intents.label: Trace the flow
intents.pedagogical_role: Follow matter, energy, information, or value
intents.choose_when: Something identifiable — matter, energy, information, money, data — enters, changes, moves, and leaves, and the learner must not lose track of it.

boundaries.when: the steps are actions taken, not a substance being followed
the point is why it happens, not where it goes
the arrangement is static and nothing travels through it

intents.label: Worked demonstration
intents.choose_when: The learner has not yet seen the method carried out end to end on a real instance, and the method is unambiguous once seen. If the learner has already seen it worked through in this lesson, this condition is no longer met.

boundaries.when: the difficulty is choosing between approaches, not executing one
the result must be justified from prior statements, not computed
the learner is attempting the work, not watching it

intents.label: Derive
intents.pedagogical_role: Build a result from prior statements
intents.choose_when: The result must be shown to FOLLOW from statements the learner already accepts, and each transformation needs a stated justification.

boundaries.when: the point is the procedure, not its justification
steps are chosen from alternatives rather than compelled
the chain is physical rather than logical

intents.label: Apply
intents.pedagogical_role: Use knowledge in a familiar situation

intents.label: Transfer
intents.pedagogical_role: Use knowledge in a changed context

intents.label: Guided practice
intents.choose_when: The learner can begin the task but will stall without prompts, partial steps, or hints.

boundaries.when: support would now be a crutch
the learner is watching rather than attempting
the point is first unaided use, not scaffolded rehearsal

intents.label: Independent practice
intents.choose_when: The learner has already succeeded with support and must now perform unaided, with enough repetition for fluency.

boundaries.when: the learner has not yet succeeded with support
the purpose is measurement, not rehearsal
the context is deliberately changed

intents.label: Quick check
intents.choose_when: The teacher needs to know right now whether the objective landed, and correct-versus-incorrect is the signal being read.

boundaries.when: wrong answers must identify WHICH wrong model the learner holds
the purpose is rehearsal rather than measurement
there is no correct answer

intents.label: Diagnose misconception
intents.pedagogical_role: Distinguish a known wrong model from the target model
intents.choose_when: A named, real misconception exists on the card, and a wrong answer can be written that only a learner holding it would confidently choose. One block per misconception the card declares — a misconception not on the card does not exist.

boundaries.when: no specific wrong model is known; the check only detects failure
the error is a slip or lapse, not a held belief
both sides are legitimate

intents.label: Watch out
intents.choose_when: A specific error is predictable at this exact point, and naming it before it happens prevents it.

boundaries.when: the error is a held belief that must be surfaced and tested, not a slip to flag
the content is a positive statement to retain, not an error to avoid

intents.label: Memory aid
intents.pedagogical_role: Support recall with a compact cue

intents.label: Summarise
intents.pedagogical_role: Compress the lesson into essential relationships

intents.label: What comes next
intents.pedagogical_role: Bridge current learning to the next idea

intents.label: Reflect
intents.pedagogical_role: Prompt learners to examine their understanding

intents.label: Evaluate
intents.pedagogical_role: Judge a claim, method, or evidence

learner_actions.label: Put items in order
learner_actions.learner_does: Arrange a set of distinct items into a defensible order.

learner_actions.label: Complete what is missing
learner_actions.learner_does: Supply the missing words, terms or values inside a given structure.

learner_actions.label: Choose one
learner_actions.learner_does: Choose exactly one option from a closed set.

learner_actions.label: Choose all that apply
learner_actions.learner_does: Choose every option that satisfies the prompt from a closed set.

learner_actions.label: Match the pairs
learner_actions.learner_does: Connect each item on one side to its counterpart on the other.

learner_actions.label: Sort into categories
learner_actions.learner_does: Assign each item to a named category using a membership rule.

learner_actions.label: Give a numeric answer
learner_actions.learner_does: Produce a numeric value, optionally with a unit.

learner_actions.label: Answer in words
learner_actions.learner_does: Produce a short written answer in the learner's own words.

learner_actions.label: Point to the right place
learner_actions.learner_does: Identify the correct region of a given visual.

learner_actions.label: Place the labels
learner_actions.learner_does: Attach each label to its correct target on a given visual.

learner_actions.label: Study the comparison
learner_actions.learner_does: Read and compare presented material without producing a response.

learner_actions.label: Read the explanation
learner_actions.learner_does: Read presented exposition without producing a response.

learner_actions.label: Write an extended answer
learner_actions.learner_does: Produce reasoning, justification or working that a teacher judges.
